s.g: Supposing that, assuming that, in the circumstances that; suppositive used to introduce a condition that may be (or prove to be) either true or false.
ex: I'll do it next week if I have time.
I'll come only if you do the driving.

s.g: A keyword that invokes conditional processing: in the event that a given condition is true, execute the given statement(s) (otherwise execute other statements).
ex: if A then B else C

s.g: Supposing that; used with past or past perfect subjunctive to indicate a counterfactual or hypothetical condition.
ex: If she hadn't told me, I wouldn't know.
If I was rich, I'd live in a big house by the sea.

s.g: Even if; even in the circumstances that.
ex: I wouldn't marry you if you were the last man on earth.
You're finishing your chowder if you sit there all afternoon!

s.g: An uncertainty, possibility, condition, doubt etc.
ex: The board can't approve this project; there are too many ifs.
